Project.name: frontend-livecoding-tasks
Project.annotation: ARMY-97 replaces the legacy card library with immutable task-ID interview practice.

UC-ARMY97-PRACTICE.Action: Open a thematic task or a static interview simulation.
UC-ARMY97-PRACTICE.AcceptanceCriteria: Every card is self-contained and every simulation is a plausible mixed frontend interview.

UC-ARMY97-PUBLISH.Action: Turn an accepted candidate into a card.
UC-ARMY97-PUBLISH.AcceptanceCriteria: Only accepted candidates receive an immutable task-XXXX path and one thematic projection.

Constraints.constraint-immutable-id: Every published task is tasks/task-XXXX/README.md; its ID is hidden, immutable, never reused, and never renumbered.
Constraints.constraint-card-contract: Card order is title, technology-mapped exact sandbox line, Условие, starter comments containing every requirement, three closed hints, closed solution, and closed five-field metadata whose duration is exactly N минут.
Constraints.constraint-provenance: No student-facing card, collection, root page, or simulation contains authorship, source provenance, import, or migration language.
Constraints.constraint-catalog: During Task 3, wave mode keeps the exact 21 legacy cards plus one complete contiguous serialized ARMY-97 prefix and requires every current task to appear in exactly one thematic collection; each ARMY-97 thematic row has the exact card title, one nonempty sentence, and the card metadata duration; after cutover, final mode requires exactly task-0001 through task-0118 across only the four controlled thematic paths with JavaScript 92, TypeScript 8, React 16, and HTML/CSS 2.
Constraints.constraint-simulations: Exactly thirty static mixed simulations satisfy 30-120 minutes, two thematic collections, three-simulation recurrence, and recorded realism evidence.
Constraints.constraint-validation: Tracked immutable candidate hash, current Markdown inventory, canonical duration, technology/editor mapping synchronized with frozen Beads card metadata, exact collection-row content, derived publication decisions, exact CardMigrationEvidence whose slug exists in the executed commit, and causal mode-bound FullCatalogGateEvidence emitted and re-verified only after the complete current wave or final catalog gate passes at current HEAD precede XML, Grace, and diff checks; nested collection provenance scanning remains Bash 3 compatible.

NonGoals.item-1: No browser, target-editor, GitHub-rendering, or CSS-layout gate.
